batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2021-2022, Set-M — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the Pathshala solved online-exam compilation PDF (compilation PDF pp.63-92; main run Q1-76 under the printed heading 'Part-A : Short Syllabus', Extra-Syllabus tail Q77-80 under 'Part B : Extra Syllabus', p.91). This compilation is a typeset online-form export, NOT a scan of the original printed paper: each question's key is the filled radio (●) printed in the compilation, cross-read against the circled letter of its printed explanation box. EXTRACTION STAGE ONLY: every question is content-unverified and every key is unverified pending cross-source verification, except the two no_correct_option items (Q55, Q77), whose answerVerificationStatus reads 'verified' only because the schema validator requires that pairing for a no_correct_option disposition — it records the compilation's own marking, not independent verification. Source-internal inconsistencies found in the compilation (marked key vs its own explanation) are documented per question in extractionNote and in the companion ANSWERS.md: Q15, Q18, Q22, Q23, Q26, Q56, Q58, Q63, Q65. Q54 is a checkbox item whose options (a) and (c) print identical text and are both marked. Two items (Q55, Q77) have the form's 5th 'Blank' radio marked; 'Blank' is excluded from the options. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: Pathshala JU A Unit 2021-2022 solved online compilation (Sets F, I, M, Q)
sourceDocuments.notes: Typeset solved online-exam compilation (124 pp.) distributed via AdmissionWar, watermarked 'Academic & Admission — Pathshala'; contains four complete JU A 2021-2022 sets (F pp.1-29, I pp.30-62, M pp.63-92, Q pp.93-124). Set-M occupies PDF pp.63-92. Answers are per-question: a filled radio (●) on the keyed option plus a worked 'Explanation' box headed 'S <circled letter> Why'. There is no answer-key table. Not an official JU document and not a scan of the original printed question paper.
